description: This file contains functions and classes for converting between Spark DataFrames and pandas or PyArrow tables, including support for Arrow-based optimizations, schema handling, and data type conversions within the PySpark framework.

classes.name: PandasConversionMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing methods to convert Spark DataFrames to pandas DataFrames and PyArrow tables.

classes.name: SparkConversionMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing methods to create Spark DataFrames from pandas DataFrames, PyArrow tables, and Arrow record batches.

methods.name: _to_pandas
methods.description: Converts a Spark DataFrame to a pandas DataFrame, optionally using Arrow optimization.

methods.name: toArrow
methods.description: Converts a Spark DataFrame to a PyArrow Table, optionally using Arrow optimization.

methods.name: _collect_as_arrow
methods.description: Collects Spark DataFrame data as a list of Arrow RecordBatches.

methods.name: _create_from_pandas_with_arrow
methods.description: Creates a Spark DataFrame from a pandas DataFrame using Arrow serialization.

methods.name: _create_from_arrow_table
methods.description: Creates a Spark DataFrame from a PyArrow Table.

methods.name: createDataFrame
methods.description: Creates a Spark DataFrame from pandas DataFrame, PyArrow Table, or schema.
